theorem totient_mul_sum_units_lift {q L : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero L] (hqL : q ∣ L) {a : ℕ → ℂ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖) (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) (β : ℝ) :
    q.totient * ∑ b ∈ (univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter IsUnit, ‖expTsum a ((b.val : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L,
        (if Ψ.conductor ∣ q then wq q Ψ.conductor else 0) * ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 :=

note: As [H] Proposition 12.1.2, up to notation. Lean needs δ0 ≥ 2 (for 2Q ≤ √x, because its common modulus includes odd q ∈ (Q, 2Q]); the book's δ0 ≥ 1 is sound, and both applications use δ0 ≥ 8. prop_12_1_2 now carries no hypotheses.
